summary: A matching archive fingerprint and record count did not prevent cache ID, repository, active-field or FTS corruption from silently omitting knowledge. Atlas now checks every visible derived record and search-content row against the cited archive before filtering, then queries a fresh temporary archive-derived FTS index. Explicit caches remain read-only. Actual Python/SQLite omission and shadow-index controls support this retrieval boundary; they establish no publisher authenticity, current deployment, stronger runtime isolation or installed consumer adoption.
title: Derived caches must not hide authoritative Atlas records
